summary: LG Display Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 22, 2026, reporting that its Board of Directors resolved to invest KRW 1.106 trillion (approximately $840 million USD) in new OLED technology infrastructure. The investment aims to enhance technological competitiveness and strengthen growth through OLED advancements. The investment period is from April 22, 2026, to June 30, 2028, with the CEO delegated to execute details. This is a routine capital expenditure disclosure, not a special situation like an acquisition or divestiture. No other terms or conditions are provided.
